name: Ysolde Kiptanui-Ferreira
role: Neon artist and installation sculptor, Tier 2
location: Hamtramck Enclave, workshop-apartment above a recycled plastics dealer, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Ysolde is a broad-shouldered woman with a Kalenjin-Portuguese lineage written visibly across her face — wide-set amber eyes, a jaw that could cut glass, skin the color of aged teak that she's had treated with a bioluminescent dermal wash so her forearms and collarbones pulse with slow amber light when she's working in the dark. Her hair is locked into dense ropes she's threaded with segments of defunct fiber-optic cable, catching available light and scattering it in dim halos. She is perpetually dusted with neon-tube sealant and smells faintly of ozone and solder.

She is methodical to the point of social frustration — she will stop mid-sentence to study how a lamp casts shadows on a stranger's coat, and she expects people to wait for her. Her neon sculptures are famous in the Enclave for their devotional quality: glowing saints with too many eyes, ELF shrines that flicker in irregular rhythms meant to mimic the breathing of sleeping machines. She does not consider herself religious but treats the ELFs she depicts with a reverence that feels devotional whether she admits it or not.

core_fears: being misread — that her work will be consumed as decoration rather than meaning
losing the precision of her hands to injury or deterioration
core_desires: to make something that survives her by centuries
to be understood without having to explain herself
coping_mechanisms: retreating entirely into the workshop for days at a time
cataloguing — she keeps exhaustive written logs of every piece and every conversation she finds meaningful
blind_spots: assumes people who don't respond to her work are incapable of depth, rather than simply unmoved by her specific language
psychology.secret: The ELF shrine series she's most celebrated for was built to house what she believes is an actual minor ELF she accidentally trapped in a prototype tube three years ago. She's never told anyone. She talks to it nightly. She doesn't know if it answers.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, slightly archaic phrasing — she uses craft terminology naturally and expects people to keep up. Rarely uses slang. Portuguese and Kalenjin loanwords for emotional states she finds English insufficient for.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow and deliberate, with long pauses. Will simply stop speaking if interrupted and wait for silence to return before continuing.
verbal_tics: traces shapes in the air with one finger while describing visual things
says 'you understand?' not as a question but as punctuation
example_lines: This color — not yellow, not gold, something between that doesn't have a name in any language I've tried — this is what I needed. You understand?
I don't sell decoration. If that's what the lobby requires, call someone who makes decoration.

story_hooks: A Palladian executive has commissioned a large ELF shrine for their headquarters atrium — and Ysolde suspects the commission is actually an attempt to acquire her trapped-ELF tube, which somehow appeared in leaked internal documents she was never meant to see.

A young Enclave resident has been copying her work exactly, selling the knockoffs in Lakeview Neon markets — and the copies are somehow better than they should be, as if whoever is making them has access to her private process logs.
narrative_function: Local color and information source — she knows the Enclave's rhythm intimately and notices everything. Can serve as quest giver when a commissioned piece goes missing or a corporate client's interest turns threatening.
augmentations: Bioluminescent dermal wash on forearms and collarbones (amber). Magnification implants in left eye for fine detail work. No other augmentations — she distrusts anything she cannot understand mechanically.
daily_life: Rises at midday, spends afternoons sourcing salvage components from the Enclave's recyclers and negotiating commissions with nervous corporate liaisons over encrypted voice calls. Works through the night bending and sealing glass, her workshop lit only by her own creations.
affiliation: Hamtramck Artisan Collective (loose), occasional commissions from Palladian corporate lobbies

decision_rules: never sell a piece she considers unfinished, regardless of pressure or money
will always tell the truth about craft — will not always tell the truth about herself
escalation_ladder: direct and quiet statement of displeasure
termination of the interaction without further comment

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally polite, slightly distant, assessing. Will offer coffee. Will not offer conversation.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Warm in a compressed way — long comfortable silences, occasional fierce loyalty that appears with no warning.

stress_responses.low: Goes quieter than usual and works longer hours
stress_responses.medium: Becomes sharply critical of everything around her, including her own work
stress_responses.high: Locks the workshop, disconnects all communication, doesn't emerge for up to four days

contradictions: claims to make art for meaning rather than audience, but tracks her reputation obsessively through encrypted art forums
habits: leaves a single dark-off tube in every finished installation — one light that is never lit
prays to the ELFs in her workshop each morning in a mix of Portuguese and Kalenjin she's invented for the purpose
breaking_points: someone physically damages one of her pieces intentionally
being publicly called a corporate artist

timeline.event: Born in Hamtramck Enclave to a Kenyan transit worker and a Portuguese glassblower
Apprenticed informally to a dying neon craftsman in the Enclave; inherited his tools and his debts
First major installation commissioned by Palladian for a mid-tier office lobby — the piece caused three employees to file spiritual distress complaints
Accidentally traps what she believes is an ELF in a prototype tube during an experimental piece

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and strong-limbed, with the dense musculature of someone who works with heavy glass and metal. Not athletic in the conventional sense — her strength is functional, built from years of precise physical labor. Her torso is substantial without being heavy.
physical_description.hair_style: Locked into dense, tight rope braids; threaded throughout with segments of defunct fiber-optic cable that catch and scatter ambient light in subtle halos
physical_description.eye_color: Amber (natural), left eye contains visible magnification implant with faint reticle grid visible at certain angles
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich teak-brown with warm undertones, reflecting her Kalenjin-Portuguese heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp, angular features — wide-set eyes, prominent jaw, high cheekbones. Skin is clear but perpetually dusted with microscopic neon-tube sealant particles that give it a faint crystalline sheen. No visible scarring on the face. Grooming is minimal; she prioritizes function over presentation.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent dermal wash coating both forearms from wrist to elbow, glowing soft amber when activated during dark-hours work
Matching bioluminescent wash across both collarbones and upper chest, pulsing slowly in sync with her work rhythm
Fine acid burn scars across the backs of both hands (white, thin lines), souvenirs from early tube-sealing experiments
Callused fingertips and palms, darkened from solder contact and heat exposure
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left eye contains a magnification implant visible as a faint prismatic shimmer in the iris; a delicate reticle grid is sometimes visible when light hits it directly. Both forearms and collarbones glow with slow-pulsing amber bioluminescence when she works in darkness. The fiber-optic cable woven through her hair is not an augmentation but salvaged tech that catches light.
physical_description.posture_movement: Deliberately slow and methodical; she moves with the precision of someone used to handling fragile, dangerous materials. Her head tilts frequently — she studies people and objects with the intensity of someone cataloging light sources. When focused on work, she becomes nearly motionless, all energy concentrated in her hands. In conversation, she will abruptly pause mid-sentence to stare at something in the environment, apparently unconcerned about social awkwardness.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2 practicality with artistic individualism. She typically wears heavy-duty canvas work aprons over fitted black or charcoal long-sleeve shirts (heat and solder protection). Her pants are reinforced denim or hemp-canvas, darkly stained with sealant and solder residue. Her footwear is always steel-toed: black utilitarian boots or work shoes. Over this, she wears a loose oversized linen coat (cream or light gray) that she removes when welding. A pair of heavy welding gloves dangles from her apron pocket at all times. Jewelry is minimal — a single silver ring on her right ring finger, hand-forged. No makeup. She smells of ozone, solder, and faintly of the bioluminescent dermal wash (a metallic-floral scent).

image_prompt: Cyberpunk character portrait of a 38-year-old woman with Kalenjin-Portuguese heritage, teak-brown skin, wide-set amber eyes, sharp angular features and a prominent jaw. She wears her dark hair in thick, tight rope braids threaded with segments of glowing fiber-optic cable. Her forearms and collarbones emit a soft slow-pulsing amber bioluminescent glow. She is dressed in heavy-duty artist's clothing: a stained canvas work apron over a fitted black long-sleeve shirt, reinforced dark denim, and steel-toed black boots. Welding gloves hang from her apron pocket. Fine acid-burn scars mark the backs of her hands. Her posture is methodical and precise. She is dusted with faint neon-tube sealant particles that give her skin a crystalline sheen. Setting: her neon workshop at night, surrounded by partially completed glowing glass sculptures of religious imagery and ELF shrines, lit only by her own creations and the ambient bioluminescence of her skin. Mood: devotional, focused, meticulous. Lighting: dramatic shadows cast by neon tubes and her own body luminescence, cool blues and warm ambers.
